subject: RENAMES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1283 (wave 1011 B2). cite.py --check 13.18.45.3 'Data-name-1, data-name-2 and data-name-3 shall not be subject to any OCCURS clauses' OK SR3. The operand and its ANCESTORS only (an alias inside a table is itself subject to the table's OCCURS); the items BETWEEN the endpoints are never tested, so a table inside the window stays legal (PB986's golden 2002/pb986_renames_through_table_window). COBOL2740 replaces the run-time NotImplementedCobolFeatureException (COBOL1756 warning) an OCCURS operand used to reach.
